customManagers.description: Stable image: pinned mcp-proxy version (ARG in Dockerfile)
Stable image: pinned mcp SDK version (ARG in Dockerfile)

packageRules.description: Automerge: every patch and minor update (Docker images, GitHub Actions, mcp-proxy/mcp) merges itself once the required CI checks pass - both images built, smoke test, mcp-supervise and mcp-manager end-to-end tests. Majors wait for a review.
mcp-proxy and the mcp SDK move together, so the pinned pair always satisfies mcp-proxy's own mcp requirement. CI (build + smoke test) gates the merge.
No mcp 2.x for the stable image: mcp-proxy (<= 0.15.0) caps mcp<2 and crashes on import with mcp 2. The :next image and the mcp2-probe workflow track that instead.

Python is locked to the 3.12 line: no minor/major upgrades (base image), because uvx servers run on the image's Python and a new minor can break them (e.g. 3.15 had no fastembed for mcp-server-qdrant). Patch and digest refreshes of 3.12 (security fixes) still come through and merge themselves. Change Python deliberately by editing the Dockerfile.
Let new mcp-proxy / mcp releases settle for 3 days before they are proposed (mcp-proxy has shipped several fix releases within a day).
